title: ATS System - Resume Parser And Analytics System
description:
ATS Resume Parser is an internal tool for a hiring agency that parses incoming resumes and saves them to a database through an automated pipeline, removing the manual data-entry burden from recruiters. Beyond parsing, it lets recruiters semantically search and match or rank candidates against the roles they are hiring for.

It is built on a Python/FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL and a JavaScript/TailwindCSS interface, and uses OpenAI LLMs orchestrated with LangChain together with a vector database — both to extract structured fields from resumes and to power the AI-driven candidate search.
